article.headline: South Dakota State earns 84-70 win over Oral Roberts
article.description: — Oscar Cluff's 21 points helped South Dakota State defeat Oral Roberts 84-70 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: South Dakota State earns 84-70 win over Oral Roberts
article.story: BROOKINGS, S.D. -- — Oscar Cluff's 21 points helped South Dakota State defeat Oral Roberts 84-70 on Saturday night. Cluff added 20 rebounds for the Jackrabbits (12-8, 3-2 Summit League). Joe Sayler scored 17 points while going 6 of 15 from the floor, including 3 for 8 from 3-point range, and 2 for 3 from the free-throw line. Matthew Mors had 11 points and shot 5 for 9, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc. Issac McBride led the way for the Golden Eagles (5-13, 1-4) with 26 points and two steals. Oral Roberts also got 15 points and seven rebounds from JoJo Moore. Jalen Miller had 15 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
